# Private Equity Intelligence Index

Source-backed research from Open Future Forum on private-equity deals, people, firms and service providers.

- Website: https://openfutureforum.github.io/private-equity-intelligence/
- Methodology: https://openfutureforum.github.io/private-equity-intelligence/methodology/
- Sources: https://openfutureforum.github.io/private-equity-intelligence/sources/
- Data: https://openfutureforum.github.io/private-equity-intelligence/data/
- Repository: https://github.com/OpenFutureForum/private-equity-intelligence

Do not infer deal participation from employment. Follow the source IDs attached to each relationship.
